description: Vendor-published incident history and announced maintenance for one system, as collected and verbatim-checked by IT連携マップ (the vendor's own records — not our observation). Returns, for the counted period: number of incidents, frequency per month, duration median/max (only for records where the vendor stated an end time — the count is given), common start weekdays and hours (JST), most-named components; the same numbers for announced maintenance; and the most recent records with the vendor's original title, an editorial Japanese translation for English titles, a short excerpt and the source URL. Read-only. Use when the user asks how often a system goes down, when its maintenance usually happens, or whether a past outage was reported. Systems without collected records return found:false.

limit.description: how many recent records to return (1-30, default 10)
